svg.title: Ampicillin structure with numbered positions for NMR assignment
svg.desc: Skeletal structure of ampicillin drawn as the free acid. The fused thiazolidine and beta-lactam rings carry standard penam position numbers: C-2 bears the gem-dimethyl group (methyl singlets near 1.5 ppm), H-3 is the thiazolidine methine near 3.9 ppm, and H-5 and H-6 are the beta-lactam methines near 5.4 ppm. The side chain at C-6 carries primed numbers: C-1' is the amide carbonyl, H-2' the side-chain methine near 4.5 ppm, and the phenyl ring positions 3' to 8' give the 5-proton aromatic multiplet at 7.3 to 7.4 ppm. Exchangeable NH and NH2 protons appear weakly above 8.5 ppm.
